name: glob3d
about: An npm package built with TypeScript and Three.js that renders an interactive 3D globe. It supports a customizable set of markers with tooltips, along with rotation and zoom. The package is published on npm and can be installed in any JavaScript project.

features.label: Functionality
items: bar-marker visualization, or a bare globe
marker highlighting on hover and click

name: hydrapp
about: A water consumption tracker for logging daily intake, reviewing weekly trends, and managing account settings. Users can view their own statistics alongside those of others. Gamification rewards consistent hydration with points and a live ranking system.

features.label: Functionality
items: stats view of each user's daily water intake

features.label: Animations
items: emojis reflecting the amount of water consumed

name: ghUsers
about: A web application for searching GitHub users by username and displaying their profile data, retrieved from the GitHub API.

features.label: Features
items: user data fetched from the GitHub API

name: tasktimer
about: A Pomodoro-style timer built with React, presented as an interactive board-game interface. It supports concurrent multitasking, so multiple tasks can run at the same time.

features.label: Functionality
items: create, edit, and remove tasks with a name, duration, and maximum break time
progress bars for elapsed and remaining time

features.label: User Interface
items: intro animation using an SVG logo with a masked cast shadow
drag and drop without third-party libraries
responsive card grid that adapts to the viewport

name: portfolio
about: A single-page portfolio showcasing selected projects, each in its own section. The site emphasizes interactivity and animation while keeping transitions performant.
Originally built in vanilla JavaScript, it was later rewritten in TypeScript and React.

features.label: Functionality
items: code splitting with Suspense and lazy loading
project details fetched from the GitHub API
custom SVG logos, graphics, and menu items
separate menu components for mobile and desktop

name: archviz
about: An architectural visualization gallery that balances high-quality imagery with load performance through SVG placeholders and visibility-based lazy loading. The site is built largely with custom JavaScript. The visualizations were created during my work as an architectural visualizer.

features.label: Functionality
items: custom responsive image grid in JavaScript, with row height based on the aspect ratios of images in that row
custom lazy loading for grid and gallery images
responsive image carousel with two display modes
